main_text.head: CARMEN
ARNOLDI GEULINXS
main_text.p: Ut nova progenies Phœnici sole peremto Nascitur è tumulo fortunataq; favilla, De tumuloque rigor redit, ac de pulvere vita, Et seri remanent infecula multa nepotes.
Sic redivivus honos tibi post tua funera, Geu-linx,

p.i: Surgit, & ipse tuis nunc redderis usque su-perstes.
Scilicet invidiæ morsus, dum vita manebat, Fortunamque nimis quondam constanter ini-quam Expertus, redis intactus post fata trium-phans.

main_text.p: Sic fortunatis natas de manibus hujus Autoris, Lector, violas mirare crocosque Spirantes, ipsos animos mulcere volentes; Quos neque tempestas, boreæ nec flamina sicci Deturpare queant, multumve nociva vetu-stas:

p.i: Hunc librum mirare alium qui pernegat esse Posse suum Dominum; nisi Palladaforsitan ipsam.

page.notes: Catchword "Frustra" repeated at the foot as the last line; a faint mark ("ꞁ") below the last line is not text. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Verse lines run together where the printed lines are set as stanzas; paragraph breaks follow the verse stanzas as printed.
